features: Speeds up first-load historical 1D Kline warm-up by loading up to 4 symbols concurrently instead of one at a time.
Reduces the fixed per-symbol warm-up delay from 1100ms to a configurable 180ms safety gap, with a small 60ms startup stagger between workers.
Keeps R2-prewarmed klines as the primary historical source and retains the existing Pionex fallback path for cache misses.
Preserves the v0.3.12 slow marquee and all TradingView Scanner, sort, search, R2 sync, and indicator calculations.
